hero.title: 研究生学习应用
hero.summary: 面向长周期学习任务。默认启用多工具能力（网络检索、计算验证、记忆整理、关系发现、多模态摄取），把预算优先投入学习过程与记忆树沉淀。

taskTemplates.title: 启动长期学习研究
taskTemplates.goal: 输入学习主题、当前水平和阶段目标，让应用制定学习路径、收集证据并沉淀记忆。
taskTemplates.description: 适合长周期学习、文献阅读和研究能力建设。
exampleTasks: 我想在 12 周内系统学习多模态大模型，请按我的数学基础安排阅读、练习和复盘。
我准备进入城市社会学方向，先帮我建立核心概念、经典文献和近期研究问题的学习路线。
我已经读了几篇论文但很散，请帮我整理主题脉络并规划下一轮阅读。
expectedOutputs: 分阶段学习路径：每周主题、阅读材料、练习任务和复盘问题。
资料与观点整理：关键论文或书籍、核心观点、适用边界和争议点。
后续研究备忘：未解问题、下一步检索方向和需要反复巩固的概念。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 建立长期学习研究循环

taskTemplates.title: 拆解论文与文献
taskTemplates.goal: 输入论文、主题或文献清单，让应用提炼论点、方法、证据和可继续追问的问题。
taskTemplates.description: 适合集中阅读论文、准备组会汇报或整理文献综述。
exampleTasks: 请帮我读懂这篇关于强化学习的论文，重点解释研究问题、实验设计和结论是否可靠。
我需要围绕“生成式 AI 对写作教学的影响”整理 15 篇文献，请归类主要观点。
我明天组会要讲一篇论文，请生成汇报提纲和可能被问到的问题。
expectedOutputs: 论文拆解卡片：研究问题、方法、数据、结论、局限和可引用观点。
文献分组表：主题类别、代表文献、共同结论和互相冲突的地方。
汇报材料草案：讲解顺序、关键图表说明和讨论问题。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 完成可复述、可讨论的文献理解

taskTemplates.title: 准备开题与研究计划
taskTemplates.goal: 输入研究兴趣、已有材料和导师要求，让应用帮助收敛题目、设计方法并形成开题材料。
taskTemplates.description: 适合论文选题、开题报告和研究计划打磨。
exampleTasks: 我想做“县城青年就业选择”的硕士论文，请帮我把兴趣收敛成可研究的问题。
导师要求我下周提交开题初稿，请根据已有材料补齐研究问题、方法和时间安排。
我的研究计划太泛，请帮我指出风险，并给出一个更可执行的版本。
expectedOutputs: 题目与研究问题建议：主问题、子问题、研究对象和边界说明。
研究方法方案：资料来源、访谈或数据计划、分析步骤和可行性风险。
开题材料骨架：章节结构、写作要点、时间表和导师沟通清单。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 形成可执行的开题与研究计划

hero.title: Graduate Study
hero.summary: A focused application for long-horizon learning. It enables a tool-rich workflow by default—web research, computational validation, memory organization, relationship discovery, and multimodal intake—so the budget is invested in learning and durable memory.

taskTemplates.title: Start a long-term learning and research loop
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the learning topic, current level, and phase goal so the application can create a learning path, collect evidence, and capture memory.
taskTemplates.description: For long-horizon learning, literature reading, and research-skill development.
exampleTasks: I want to learn multimodal large models systematically in 12 weeks. Plan readings, exercises, and reviews around my math background.
I am entering urban sociology. First build a learning route for core concepts, classic literature, and current research questions.
I have read several papers but they feel scattered. Help me organize the themes and plan the next reading round.
expectedOutputs: Phased learning path: weekly themes, readings, exercises, and review questions.
Sources and viewpoints: key papers or books, central claims, boundaries of applicability, and disputes.
Research memo: unanswered questions, next search directions, and concepts that need repeated reinforcement.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Build a long-term learning and research loop

taskTemplates.title: Analyze papers and literature
taskTemplates.goal: Provide papers, a topic, or a reading list so the application can extract claims, methods, evidence, and follow-up questions.
taskTemplates.description: For concentrated paper reading, group-meeting preparation, or literature-review organization.
exampleTasks: Help me understand this reinforcement-learning paper, focusing on the research question, experiment design, and whether its conclusion is reliable.
I need to organize 15 papers on the impact of generative AI on writing education. Group the main viewpoints.
I present a paper at tomorrow's group meeting. Generate an outline and likely questions.
expectedOutputs: Paper analysis card: research question, method, data, conclusion, limitations, and quotable insights.
Literature grouping: topic categories, representative work, shared conclusions, and conflicts.
Presentation draft: explanation order, key-chart notes, and discussion questions.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Build a repeatable, discussable understanding of the literature

taskTemplates.title: Prepare a thesis proposal and research plan
taskTemplates.goal: Provide research interests, existing materials, and advisor requirements so the application can narrow the topic, design methods, and produce proposal materials.
taskTemplates.description: For thesis topic selection, proposal reports, and research-plan refinement.
exampleTasks: I want to write a master's thesis on employment choices among young people in county-level cities. Help turn the interest into a researchable question.
My advisor expects a proposal draft next week. Use my existing materials to complete the research question, method, and schedule.
My research plan is too broad. Identify the risks and provide a more executable version.
expectedOutputs: Topic and research-question suggestions: primary and secondary questions, subjects, and scope.
Research-method plan: sources, interview or data plan, analysis steps, and feasibility risks.
Proposal outline: chapter structure, writing points, timeline, and advisor-communication checklist.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Create an executable thesis proposal and research plan
